description: Property identifier. If the input file had an `aoi_id` column it is preserved; otherwise generated from row index (0-indexed).
Area of the roof, in square metres.
The unique ID for the class of this feature.
Area of the roof clipped to the parcel boundary, in square metres.
Confidence in detection of the roof (single feature, not combined).
A description of the class of this feature.
Area of the dominant material component on the primary roof.
Confidence in the dominant material classification.
Snake_case name of the dominant material feature class (`unknown` when ratio < 0.5). Open-ended; consult the Feature API class registry for the full list of possible values.
Feature class UUID of the dominant roof material. Dominant = highest-ratio component; UNKNOWN (null) when ratio < 0.5.
Ratio of the dominant material relative to total roof area.
Area of the dominant shape component on the primary roof.
Confidence in the dominant shape classification.

Snake_case name of the dominant shape feature class (`unknown` when no detected area). Open-ended; consult the Feature API class registry for the full list of possible values. Excludes deprecated flat roof and `shed`.
Feature class UUID of the dominant roof shape. Dominant = highest-ratio component; UNKNOWN (null) when no detected area.
Feature ID of the roof.
Quality of the shape of the vectorized footprint polygon (and implicitly the accuracy of the area measurement).
Total area of gable detected on this roof, in square metres.

Confidence in gable classification on this roof. When multiple detections contribute: top-level feature classes on the parcel (e.g. all roofs, all vegetation segments) are combined so confidence rises with corroborating detections; sub-attributes within a parent feature (e.g. staining on a roof) take the maximum across detections. Null when the corresponding area is 0.
Whether any gable is detected on this roof.
Ratio of gable detected on this roof.

Whether this feature is the parcel's primary feature for its class — selected by the largest-intersection strategy (see README → Primary Feature Selection).

URL to view this row in Nearmap MapBrowser. Per-class files (roof, building, etc.) frame the URL on each feature's centroid; the rollup frames it on the parcel.

Date of the 3D mesh used for 3D attributes (height, pitch, etc.). The mesh is usually comprised of a number of overlapping surveys captured at a similar time of year, so this date represents that capture window rather than a single survey.
